cases.fixture: Keep exactly 64 KiB available. Race two 64 KiB contenders on one connection, then race across two. Repeat against the configured site cap.
cases.expected: Exactly one reservation at each contested cap. Track reserved, accepted and uncertain bytes together.
cases.prohibited: Overcommit, uncharged transfer, shared-read accounting, or early credit return.
cases.environment: Linux reference callback tests and hosted Windows synthetic CI cover both caps. Selected Windows TLS must associate independently observed egress and occupancy with both ledgers.
cases.evidence: Windows synthetic CI job and exact-capacity trace vector

cases.fixture: Reserve 64 KiB. Observe 16 KiB accepted, zero-byte refusal on a fresh attempt, then an ambiguous attempt and duplicate settlement.
cases.expected: Release only the proven unused suffix. Keep full ambiguous credit until independent drain or termination. Retry only with fresh admission for an exact unaccepted suffix.
cases.prohibited: Replay, lost or duplicate charge, credit reset on close/timeout, offset retry after an ambiguous result.
cases.environment: Synthetic trace vectors plus Linux reference callback evidence. Selected Windows TLS terminal evidence is open.
cases.evidence: Reference callback tests and partial/zero/uncertain trace vector

cases.capability: Terminal handoff vs durable withdrawal fence
cases.fixture: Pause between protected slices, accept withdrawal, then resume. Run header, active-body, queued, reconnect and unaffected controls.
cases.expected: No affected terminal handoff after independently observed durable acceptance. Previously accepted bytes may arrive later. Unaffected access continues.
cases.prohibited: Application-log-only proof, affected protected headers/body accepted after fence, or claiming retroactive deletion.
cases.environment: Independent Linux loopback client and reference pause hook exercise in-memory mid-body denial. Hosted Windows CI proves only its synthetic control. Selected Windows durable fence, residual and unrelated-route evidence are open.
cases.evidence: Independent loopback cancellation result and trace vector

cases.capability: Slow clients, backpressure and withdrawal progress
cases.fixture: Hold a real client slow while 25 browsers and 10 queries contend. Measure occupied capacity, nonblocking returns and valid-update admission-to-durable acknowledgment.
cases.expected: Bounded attempted slices and occupancy plus prompt withdrawal, with p95 ≤1 s and maximum ≤5 s as proposed inputs.
cases.prohibited: Blocked handoff guard, unbounded queue, starvation, or returning success during uncertain durability.
cases.environment: Linux short benchmark is informative only. Slow paused loopback receipt is not transport backpressure. Selected Windows reference-load and drain probes are open.
cases.evidence: Three timed reference samples summarized in transport.md

cases.capability: Authorized metadata and large-PDF near-end navigation
cases.fixture: Use pinned PDF.js with an authenticated browser, synthetic 396,871-byte PDF, first page and jump to page 12.
cases.expected: Authorized bounded metadata before byte requests, exact copy pin, single bounded ranges from first byte fetch, exact 206 and Content-Range/Length, rendered pages.
cases.prohibited: Unbounded or anonymous delivery, protected direct URL, optimistic 206, stale cache, or fallback full response.
cases.environment: Linux browser runner and independent HTTP client observed bounded near-end access. Selected Windows authenticated TLS browser evidence is open.
cases.evidence: Independent Chromium reference record and loopback HTTP check

cases.fixture: Try unauthenticated metadata/range, stale copy identity, and full, malformed, oversized, duplicate and conditional range requests. Repeat after withdrawal.
cases.expected: No protected size/header/body on unauthorized or withdrawn requests, no 304, exact eligible bounded control remains usable.
cases.prohibited: Size-bearing errors, status depending on withdrawn range validity, 304 reuse, silently shortened or unbounded response.
cases.environment: Independent Linux loopback client and hosted Windows reference suite have synthetic controls. Selected Windows actual authenticated path evidence is open.
cases.evidence: Independent loopback HTTP check and hosted Windows CI job

cases.fixture: Cancel affected stream and reset an uncertain route. Restart across prepared-only, durable-CAS, missing-current-witness and wrong-witness conditions.
cases.expected: Keep credit until trusted proof and prohibit affected replay. Rebuild exact committed effective state or halt. Admin ack follows durable CAS.
cases.prohibited: Reopen from stale or missing current authority, free uncertain credit on restart, ack a prepared-only update, or reattach stale stream.
cases.environment: Synthetic trace vectors exercise reconciliation and cancellation. Reference harness has only in-memory withdrawal. Selected Windows witness, storage and crash evidence are open.
cases.evidence: Trace-vector self-test only for restart and witness cases

cases.fixture: Pause an actual browser on a mid-range transfer, withdraw exact copy, then perform viewer refresh/retry and open unrelated eligible PDF.
cases.expected: Cancel affected requests, clear rendered application-controlled state, deny new affected handoffs, and keep unrelated viewer usable.
cases.prohibited: Additional protected handoff after durable fence, stale viewer replay or blanket denial required to pass.
cases.environment: Independent Python HTTP client observed cancellation only. Linux browser runner covers positive rendering only. Selected Windows TLS browser cancellation remains open.
cases.evidence: Reference HTTP cancellation and separate positive Chromium render
